name: AMGR
author: L'Cronx
summary: Four-layer granular sample mangler in the spirit of the Tasty Chips GR-2, aimed at much lower resource consumption. Touch a layer's waveform to set where its grains spawn from: per-layer ADSR, density/size/spread/jitter/reverse, a CPU-safety governor, a file browser per layer, a factory bank that varies every parameter, delay and reverb.
